page.title: Can AI Replace a CMS? | Lab | Dr. Paul Ress, DBA
page.meta_description: Experiment 1: Dr. Paul tests what happens when AI takes over the traditional website production workflow — and finds execution wasn’t the constraint.
page.social_description: Experiment 1: Dr. Paul tests what happens when AI takes over the traditional website production workflow.

lede: Dr. Paul tests what happens when AI takes over much of the traditional website production workflow.
hypothesis_text: AI can eliminate much of the production layer when given the right constraints.
result_text: Execution wasn’t the constraint. Judgment was — this page is itself running evidence.
limitations_text: Single-subject test, still running — not a controlled study. Read this as one practitioner’s evidence, not a general claim.

worked_text: AI handled the implementation surprisingly well.
constraint_text: Context mattered — without enough of it, AI drifted.
evidence_heading: The real numbers behind this page
evidence_lede: Pulled straight from this repository’s own commit history — nothing estimated, nothing invented.
finding_support: AI can quickly build what’s requested. The harder question is whether it’s worth building.
implication_text: AI doesn’t replace the marketer. It changes where the marketer adds value.
takeaway_text: Don’t just add AI to the workflow. Redesign the workflow around AI.
